limits: Two previously observed held-out worlds and one founder, pre-sleep only; not an independent validation or new training experiment.
Conditional payloads, cue-bank swaps and shadow optimizer steps do not execute world actions and do not establish learning or competence.
The encoder bank contains native word and bodily contributions; swaps hold all other recorded replay context fixed but are not a pure semantic intervention.
No source checkpoint mutation, default-brain migration, promotion, real SLM request or Luna retry.
Conditional correct payloads are not spoken outcomes. Eligible action-selection misses and cooldown-blocked proposals are counted separately for each arm.
The shadow objective is a single recorded example, not the actual aggregate curriculum gradient; local loss reduction does not prove language learning or predict a training fix.
Actual utterances require native world emission; a selected vocal channel or decoded payload alone is not spoken success.

limits: One retained founder, six previously observed held-out world/sampling seeds. This is a bounded correction test, not blind validation or independent training replication.
Pre/post induced RecoveryProtocol sleep are paired on each seed; no spontaneous-sleep or awake-delay causal control.
All scored teacher/prior-off physical actions and actual utterances are unforced. Conditional payloads and native shadow updates are diagnostic only.
All arms clone the same V17 grounded actor and full native Adam/private history. Untouched takes no updates; no-new-teacher retains earlier language learning and natural self-speech.
Actual factual-label counts can differ with physical trajectories. No event, reward or positive label is manufactured to balance an absent activity.
The factual noun margin contrasts code 3 only for truthful GetFood/GetToy examples. Retention of that noun in other contexts is unmeasured.
Teacher remains ordinary scripted spatial speech; no learned SLM delivery was verified, and the Luna WebSocket 401 was not retried or bypassed.
The cold next-Adam check uses the saved real gradient, not a newly recomputed gradient.
No default or accepted brain migration, source-state overwrite, live/PC training change, promotion or merge.
